_comment: FlexRadio DAX-IQ example (flex_iq.py). Copy to <name>.local.json and set callsign, grid and sdr_ip. Each SparkGap copy uses one DAX-IQ channel, one pan, one slice and part of the radio's DAX-IQ budget: 16 units on a 6400, 6600 or 6700, of which a stream takes 2 at 48 kHz, 4 at 96 kHz and 8 at 192 kHz, shared with SmartSDR and DAX. So up to 4 copies at 96 kHz on a FLEX-6600 or 6700 (2 at 192 kHz) and 2 on a 6400; fewer while other programs stream DAX-IQ. Every copy needs its own flex_daxiq_channel, flex_udp_port, telnet_port and skimmer_suffix (the GUI feed takes the next free port from 7321 to 7339 (7320 is the SparkGap server's) by itself); a channel another program holds is refused at start. Tested at 96 kHz. telnet stays on localhost until you mean to feed a cluster.
_comment_flex_loop: Optional: flex_rxant (e.g. "ANT1"), flex_loopa / flex_loopb (true/false) are set on SparkGap's pan and slice. Leave them out to keep the radio's band setting. Set them when another receiver hangs on a receive loop: a pan or slice that comes up with the loop off switches it off for everything on that antenna (a second skimmer on RX loop B goes deaf).
_comment_cw_decoder: itila2 is the default chain: the itila2 decoder and scanner together, with the repeat spot rule (hotairfred/SparkGap#18, with itila_decode_threads); cw_decoder itila selects the original one. See docs/ITILA2.md.
_comment_spot_validation: A confidence score decides which calls spot (docs/ITILA2.md); rbn+skcc adds calls known from the RBN archives and the SKCC roster, cached in rbn_known_dir. Measured on the 24-hour dry run, cdub89/SparkGap#10.
_comment_gui_feed: SparkGap Web (docs/SERVER_SETUP.md). On loopback only, with no join code; set bind and join_code to reach it from another machine.
